request: Add a system status command that reports whether Jiraiya's memory, knowledge, web and LLM components are healthy.

plan.title: Check Jiraiya Component Health
plan.goal: Ensure all Jiraiya components are functioning correctly.
plan.reason: A healthy system is essential for effective operation.
changes: Add a new command to the agent.py file that checks the health of each component.
Update the deployment log to include the status of each component.
tests: Create a test to verify that the new command correctly reports the health of each component.
Create a test to verify that the deployment log is updated correctly with the status of each component.
plan.rollback: If the component health check fails, revert the changes made to the agent.py file and update the deployment log to reflect the previous status.
